culpritSource.quote: After solving clues Takagi leaves suddenly and Conan reveals who the kidnapper is. Just then, Kouta returns home unharmed, making them believe the culprit (Takuji Rokuda) will try to make a run for it. After arriving to Rokuda's house it is revealed that a winning lottery ticket was returned to the culprit in his mailbox, making him realise his friends had no intention of stealing money from him. The guilt Rokuda feels upon this realisation is so crushing that he decides it's best for him to kill himself.
